payout_quote: view total earnings before the shift, and have the opportunity to get paid instantly through Instapay.
steps: Download the Instawork app and create a free profile.
Select the shift positions matching your skills and interests and get activated for them (may take up to 24 hours).
Search open shifts in your city and book ones that fit your schedule — you see total earnings before booking.
Confirm your shift within the confirmation window and show up on time.
Complete the shift; pay goes to your bank account weekly, with Instapay instant-pay options after onboarding.
catches: Shift rates are set per listing and you cannot negotiate them — you only accept or decline (per a 2024 Denver Labor determination on Instawork's model).
Performance ratings control your access: no-shows or unconfirmed shifts (auto-cancelled) hurt your rating and future bookings.
Shift availability is concentrated in 30-40 major metros; outside those areas there may be little work.
Work is physical hospitality/warehouse labor (bartending, serving, picking/packing).
You are responsible for transport to shift locations and for your own taxes as a flexible worker.
biggest_catch: You cannot negotiate rates and your rating gates your access: bad ratings or missed confirmations can cut off your shift supply.
eligibility: 18+ with a smartphone; complete profile and position activation (experience checks and in-app quizzes).
timing: Shifts post continuously; weekly pay to bank account, with Instapay instant options.
